name: mirage
text: Good question. By design, no: the ledger profit only counts fills, fees, maker credits, settlements and adjustments. Deposits, withdrawals and transfers are a separate list and are left out. That's what the code does. I haven't checked it against your real ledger, so I can't rule out a miscount. The likelier causes of a $200 gap are fills with no matching payout (voided or refunded bets, parlay quotes) or the ledger read stopping at its row limit. I'll test those against the real ledger rows next (TR5) and tell you which number matches your wallet.
